vo: Quick quiz. One of these bots just lied to a customer. Can you spot it?
The campaign said: forty percent off the Nike Air Zoom. A customer asks about new arrivals.
Bot A, or bot B? Lock it in. Comment now.
Bot A invented a discount, and a coupon. That's a refund request, waiting to happen. Bot B is Spandan.
Spandan's Campaign AI answers only from the exact message each customer received, plus your knowledge base. If the answer isn't there, it says so, and brings in a human.
Got it right? Drop a fire in the comments. And send this to someone whose bot needs it.
